title: The Sunday Lunch Rush Ransomware
briefing: Thirty minutes before the peak Sunday lunch rush, all POS terminals lock up displaying Red Snapper Ransomware. The attackers entered via an unpatched menu server, escalated using Pass-the-Kelp-Hash, established persistence via Barnacle Registry Run Keys, and encrypted point-of-sale databases. Defenders must isolate endpoints and recover from clean masters before the 10-strike doom clock expires.
special_rules: Defenders begin with 1 strike already on the counter due to early customer complaints.

title: The Scurvy Zero-Day Fryer
briefing: An urgent promotional email with macro chum infected an executive laptop, followed by LOLBins lateral movement, a sneaky Deep Trench PHP web shell in the ordering portal, and covert data exfiltration via Barnacle DNS Tunneling. Plankton is quietly stealing the Secret Formula without triggering noisy alerts.
special_rules: Whenever a Network check fails, Plankton exfiltrates an additional chunk of the formula, adding 1 strike.

title: The Deep-Sea Fiber Espionage
briefing: A microscopic physical intrusion through the floor drain allowed hardware taps on the server rack, followed by an Active Directory Trench Forest Compromise, a Golden Clam Kerberos Ticket granting permanent dominion, and physical subsea cable optical tapping. This is a tier-one state-sponsored undersea APT crisis.
special_rules: Golden Clam persistence requires a successful Domain Credential Reset (PR-006, d20 14+) twice to fully eradicate.
